export_metadata.purpose: complete read-only route database export for independent audit
notes: Original IDs and stored values are preserved; no normalisation, correction or modification was applied.
Decimal coordinates are serialised as floats at their stored precision.
route_shapes.geojson values are kept exactly as stored (parsed JSON).

sources.source_name: Sindh Mass Transit Authority — Karachi route directory
sources.notes: Official route directory accessed 2026-11-16. SMTA notes that the route map is courtesy of Think Transportation and disclaims authentication of third-party service data. Record route details as pending review; not sufficient alone to activate routes.

sources.source_name: Provincial Assembly of Sindh — BRT Orange Line service information
sources.notes: Assembly response dated 2026-01-29 states Orange Line operates between TMA Office, Orangi Town and Jinnah University for Women. Endpoint metadata only; detailed station sequence not supplied here.

sources.source_name: Shehri — BRT TOD Design Booklet (Green Line alignment)
sources.notes: Historical planning/alignment reference. Not used to claim a current verified station list. Green Line route direction endpoints only are seeded.

sources.source_name: Karachi Bus Network Research Dataset (user-provided cleaned files)
sources.notes: User-provided cleaned research files: 572 stop-node coordinates and 1,415 directed stop-to-stop edges across 76 route identifiers. Original publication, author, date and redistribution licence have not yet been independently confirmed. Dataset may contain historical/private services and must not be treated as proof of current operation. Imported records remain pending review.
